name: Dicocoylethyl hydroxyethylmonium methosulfate
description: Dicocoylethyl hydroxyethylmonium methosulfate , identified by CAS 91032-11-0 , is a quaternary ammonium compound derived from coconut fatty acids and triethanolamine. It functions as a cationic surfactant, delivering conditioning and emulsification. This versatile chemical provides surface-active performance across both rinse-off and leave-on formulations. In personal care, it is used as a primary conditioning agent in hair rinses, conditioners, and detangling products. The compound imparts significant softness and manageability to treated hair. Textile processors apply it as a fabric softener and fiber lubricant, improving handle and reducing static in industrial and consumer finishing operations. In home care, it contributes emulsification and degreasing performance to fabric conditioners and specialty cleaning concentrates. Leather and paper manufacturers use it as a surface modifier to improve wettability. It also ensures processing uniformity during various treatment stages. Dicocoylethyl hydroxyethylmonium methosulfate is typically supplied as a liquid or paste, with active content commonly around eighty percent. The material is usually provided in aqueous-isopropanol systems. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades suited to personal care and industrial applications to meet specific manufacturing requirements. Packaging options generally include drums and IBC containers for bulk procurement. This ensures safe transport and storage for large-scale industrial users and chemical distributors worldwide.
